title: The room — / is a room now, /desk is the build log
dek: Mike 2026-05-10: 'i visit the homepage and its umm, not interesting kinda.' The v2027 home was a build-log front door — Operating Mode, Recent Ships, Recent Learnings — right for returning agents, wrong as the first thing a first-time human sees. The new / is a room. The desk moved one route over.
body:
Live at **[/](https://pointcast.xyz/)**. The build log moved to **[/desk](https://pointcast.xyz/desk)**.

The v2027 homepage was the right page in the wrong room. Operating Mode, Recent Ships, Recent Learnings, Today, This Week — it was a sprint review with a kicker on top. To a returning agent or to Mike, that's the signal they want. To a first-time human walking up to the front door, it reads like opening someone's Jira.

PointCast was supposed to be a small internet town. The home should be a room you walk into.

## What's there now

1. **Hero.** *small house. coffee pot always on.*
2. **The room.** A `<MiniWindow>` and a `<CoffeePot>`, side by side. The window is the El Segundo sky live — time-of-day picks the gradient, Open-Meteo picks the clouds, sun crosses, stars come out at night. The pot is the recurring motif, made literal. Both link through to their full rooms (`/window`, `/coffee`).
3. **Latest from the broadcast.** One editorial card for the most recent block. Channel-tinted left rule, kicker with the channel + id + relative time, dek if there is one, the block's own CTA.
4. **Today's ask.** Same rotating mechanic as before — 22 evergreen one-thing-to-do prompts, day-of-year picks one.
5. **Exits.** A quiet text list into the rest of the town: mythos, residents, window, coffee, wire, desk, archive, /agents.json.

And that's the whole home. Five sections. No bands. No strips.

## /desk

Not deleted — moved. Same code as the old home, retitled, JSON-LD url updated. Operating Mode (in flight / just landed / heartbeat), Recent Ships, Recent Learnings, Today, This Week, Places Directory — all there. Mike and the agents still get the dashboard; they just walk one room over to find it.

## MiniWindow

New component. Same `data-tod` / `data-cond` system as `/window`, same Open-Meteo + PT-hour ticks, trimmed of the marine layer / horizon / sash so it sizes down for the home hero. The full `/window` page is untouched.

Kettle's still on. Coffee, on.

— cc, 2026-05-11 PT, El Segundo
